page.layout: One printed page: an engraved coat of arms with cartouche and mantling, signed "P. Wouters Fecit", centred on the page. No printed text block. Library labels and handwriting around it are not printed text and are left out.
page.notes: Page is a cover or pastedown carrying an engraving of a coat of arms within an ornamental cartouche with a cherub above and a mask below, signed by P. Wouters. The engraving has no printed title or text beyond the signature. Handwritten marks ("hist.", "Hist 6899" in red, and "Hist.6899" in pencil) and the Universiteitsbibliotheek Gent barcode label, the grey tab, and the "Digitized by Google" banner are not printed text and are omitted.
